user.description: Pick the voice satellites whose timers should appear as sensors for your dashboard. Timers you set by voice keep working exactly as they do now; this only mirrors them so cards can show them.
user.title: Satellite Timers

assist_unsupported.description: Home Assistant changed how voice timers work internally. Satellite Timers has switched itself off rather than risk breaking your voice timers. Check for an update to Satellite Timers.
assist_unsupported.title: Satellite Timers cannot read voice timers

undelivered_timer_events.description: A finished timer was dismissed, but the hub could not confirm the satellite stopped ringing: the stop message could not be delivered. The satellite may still be ringing. The hub keeps retrying the stop and clears this warning when the stop is sent on a liveness signal and leaves the queue, when a newer event for the same timer replaces it, or when the record expires after 24 hours.
undelivered_timer_events.title: A dismissed timer may still be ringing

data.q11_ring_timing: Timer finished while the system was down

init.description: Pick the voice satellites whose timers should appear as sensors. The primary satellite is the one a dashboard timer rings when no satellite is named; leave it unset with a single satellite. A timer that finished while the system was down never rings — it is shown, not announced — and a stopped alarm is never re-rung. Satellite alarm behaviour stays 'Not yet measured' until the listen test measures what the satellite firmware does when a timer finishes.
init.title: Satellite Timers
